summary: T3 follow-up after report 494c848. Completed the remaining R1 substitutions: the five D-pad dot/glow literals now use T2's new theme tokens (values verified byte-identical against agent/worker-1 35d5343), with tile fill/edge/ring already on theme::SLATE_100/theme::BORDER and all pixel metrics kept local. Reverted the Restore icon ink to the original Iced behaviour (fixed slate-600; other action icons still inherit the label ink) under migration constraint 5, keeping the readable placeholder-based label and the content + 2 * 13px width, and added regression coverage that fails if the single-ink change is applied. T2's five D-pad tokens do NOT yet exist on agent/integration (f3dc2d9), so the integrator must merge T2's follow-up before this branch. Font weight, long-label hover-scroll and banner behaviour remain open and untouched.

review_actions.required: Paint the icon with the same ink variable as the label (rework of 494c848).
review_actions.changed: Deliberately NOT preserved: migration constraint 5 outranks the reviewer suggestion. The icon ink rule is restored to the original Iced `icon_label`: `action_icon_ink(kind, label_ink)` returns ICON_SECONDARY for an `Icon::Restore` glyph in every state and the label ink for other icons. The label still follows its state ink (slate-600 at rest, indigo-600 on hover) and is still laid out with PLACEHOLDER, so the readable-label fix stands; the width stays `content + 2.0 * BUTTON_PAD_X` with the 30px height.
review_actions.evidence: Original behaviour verified in the source of truth: src/ui/app.rs `icon_label` carries the comment 'Restore affordances use the reference's slate-600 ink; other action icons inherit the button text color so hover states keep working.' and codes it as `matches!(name, Icon::Restore).then_some(theme::ICON_SECONDARY)`, so the Restore glyph never recolours while src/ui/theme.rs `secondary_button` moves text_color to INDIGO_600 on hover. Two new tests cover it: `other_action_icons_follow_the_button_ink` (both branches of the rule) and `the_restore_icon_keeps_the_iced_slate_ink_on_hover`, a shape-level test that reads the strokes clips to the button rect and asserts ICON_SECONDARY is present and INDIGO_600 is absent, at rest and while hovered. Probe: with the single-ink change re-applied in the scratch copy the test fails at 'the Restore glyph must paint in the secondary slate (hovered: true)' (exit 101), then the scratch was re-synced and the suite passed again. This deviation is stated here for re-review; ui.md was not touched and no parity was silently waived.

risks: Merge order: this branch now imports theme::DPAD_GUIDE_DOT, theme::DPAD_ACTIVE_GLOW, theme::DPAD_ACTIVE_DOT_SHADOW, theme::DPAD_IDLE_DOT_SHADOW and theme::DPAD_IDLE_DOT, which exist on agent/worker-1 (35d5343) but NOT on agent/integration (f3dc2d9). Merging T3 before T2's follow-up will fail to compile; T2's token commit must land first.

The full theme surface T3 imports is BODY_TEXT, MUTED_TEXT, ICON_MUTED, ICON_SECONDARY, PRIMARY_TEXT, INDIGO_600, INDIGO_700, INDIGO_800, IMMEDIATE_ACCENT, VIOLET_600, MIX_TEXT, SLATE_100, ERROR_BG, ERROR_BORDER, ERROR_TEXT, GREEN_CHECK, RED_600, EMERALD_700, BORDER, INSET, SURFACE, CARD_BORDER, HOVER_WASH, NAME_HOVER_BORDER, KEYCAP_HOVER_BG, KEYCAP_HOVER_BORDER, KEYCAP_REBIND_EDGE, SHADOW_KEYCAP, SHADOW_CARD, SHADOW_BANNER, KEYCAP_REBIND_GLOW_BLUR, KEYCAP_PRESSED_GLOW_BLUR, HEADING_SIZE, SECTION_GAP and KeycapMode. All verified present (the first block on agent/integration f3dc2d9, the DPAD_* block on agent/worker-1 35d5343); a rename or removal breaks the merge.

Branch limitation: this branch does not register the modules and has no egui_kittest dev-dependency, so no in-tree command compiles T3. All T3 execution evidence comes from the scratch harness at %TEMP%/kilo/t3scratch, which mirrors this worktree's src, registers the modules, copies agent/worker-1's theme.rs read-only and appends the dev-dependency (sync.ps1 is in that directory). It is outside the repo and not committed.

Secondary-button icon ink is deliberately back to the Iced behaviour (Restore glyph fixed at slate-600), which deviates from R1's requested shared ink variable. Recorded for re-review; if ui.md parity is judged to require the shared ink instead, the change is a one-line call-site edit and the test would need to be inverted.

Still open and NOT solved by this follow-up: the font-weight strategy (egui has no bold face; keycap.rs keeps the double-stamp approximation), long-keycap-label hover-scroll, and the pulsing capture banner. No claim is made about them here.
Native visual acceptance remains pending as docs/architecture/verification.md records; the kittest tests cover semantics, painted text colour and painted stroke colour, not the whole rendered layout.
